body:
## What it does

It writes the script and waits for your approval before generating anything, which keeps a text-to-video tool from spending your budget on a premise you would have rejected. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @altryne shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
